subject: Newbie question regarding alternate date format input from Excel

messages.author: b2fa09e27fc4e9c0
messages.subject: Newbie question regarding alternate date format input from Excel
parts:
I am new to R (as you can probably guess) and I am trying to import some simple data from Excel:

1]  myDate   datapoint1  datapoint2...
2]  07/2012      1.0             1.5   ...
3]  08/2012      1.4             6.9
.
.
.

So essentially month/year.  Using read.xlsx directly interprets myDate as a factor.  I can use read.xlsx2 and specify the colClasses as "Date"

mydataframe2 <- read.xlsx2(workbook2, 1, colClasses=c("Date",rep("numeric",5)))

read.xlsx2 correctly reads in the data type as "Date" but read.xlsx2 doesn't recognize the month/year formatting:

> str(mydataframe2)
'data.frame':   24 obs. of  6 variables:
 $ myDate        : Date, format: NA NA NA NA ...
 $ All.Patients: num  15.62 6.6 4.29 8.96 3.53 ...
 $ n13under    : num  7.41 0 0 7.38 4.76 ...
 $ n14over     : num  26.19 11.48 7.69 11.39 2.33 ...
 $ n15under    : num  6.56 0 0 6.67 4.17 ...
 $ n16over     : num  31.4 14.6 10.3 13.6 2.7 ...

Any suggestions how I can read in the month/year data with the xlsx package?

The month/year column in the .xls spreadsheet is formatted as a Date.
